description: > We are Luna sola from Faisalabad, Pakistan. We explore space through storytelling, art, and emotion. Our project, 'Silent heroes :Space Lagacy Museume'​ left behind but never forgotten. We are looking for members who think deeply, create softly, and love to tell meaningful stories.
summary:
SILENT HEROES — Space Legacy Digital Museum
Slogan: The Machines We Left Behind.
​SILENT HEROES is an interactive digital museum dedicated to preserving the stories and engineering legacy of the machines humanity left behind on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
​Designed to make space history engaging, educational, and accessible to everyone, the platform brings robotic exploration to life through seven interactive experiences:
​Mission Archive: Detailed stories and technical profiles of iconic space missions and equipment.
​Interactive Map: Explore exact landing sites and exploration zones across other worlds.
​3D Explorer: Inspect interactive 3D models of historic spacecraft and rovers up close.
​Historical Timeline: Trace the key milestones that shaped humanity’s journey into deep space.
​Mission Films: Curated documentaries and footage capturing historic breakthroughs.
​Interactive Quiz: Challenge and expand your space exploration knowledge.
​AI Space Guide: An intelligent assistant to answer visitor questions and deepen learning.
details:
Silent Heroes is a web platform that highlights the unsung heroes behind space missions - the engineers, scientists, doctors, and ground teams whose work makes every NASA mission possible but who are rarely celebrated.

Our website allows users to explore stories of these silent heroes, learn about their roles, and understand how teamwork, science, and technology come together in a space mission. Users can search heroes by mission, role, and contribution, and read interactive stories with images and timelines.

The intended impact is to inspire students, especially girls in Pakistan, to see themselves in STEM and space careers. We want to show that you do not need to be an astronaut to be a hero in space science.

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Canva for design. Our team considered accessibility, simple language, and mobile-friendly design so that students in schools with low internet can also use it easily. Our project is creative because it focuses on human stories behind data, not just rockets and planets.
